content.shloka:
Shri Vishnum Jishnum Mahavishnum Prabha Vishnum Maheshvaram
Aneka Roopa Daityantam Namami Purushottamam
content.meaning: I bow to Sri Vishnu, the victorious, the great all-pervading Lord, the radiant one, the supreme controller. I salute the one who assumes many forms, the destroyer of demons, the Supreme Being.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Viṣṇuṃ Jiṣṇuṃ Mahāviṣṇuṃ Prabhā Viṣṇuṃ Maheśvaram
Aneka Rūpa Daityāntaṃ Namāmi Puruṣottamam

content.shloka:
Vishvam Vishnur Vashatkaro Bhootabhavya Bhavatprabhuh
Bhootakrit Bhootabhrit Bhavo Bhootatma Bhootabhavanah
content.meaning: He who is the universe, all-pervading, the master of all offerings, the Lord of past, present, and future, the creator and sustainer of all beings, the existence itself, the soul of all creatures, and the nourisher of all.
content.transliteration:
Viśvaṃ Viṣṇur Vaṣaṭkāro Bhūtabhavya Bhavatprabhuḥ
Bhūtakṛt Bhūtabhṛt Bhāvo Bhūtātmā Bhūtabhāvanaḥ

content.shloka:
Atmaatma Bhootaatma Mahaatma Soorya Varchasvine Namah
Vaasudevaya Shantaya Namo Namo Namostute
content.meaning: Salutations to the Self of all selves, the soul of all beings, the great soul, the one radiant like the sun. Repeated salutations to Vasudeva, the peaceful one.
content.transliteration:
Ātmātmā Bhūtātmā Mahātmā Sūrya Varcasvine Namaḥ
Vāsudevāya Śāntāya Namo Namo Namostute

content.shloka:
Shantakaaram Bhujagashayanam Padmanaabham Suresham
Vishvadhaaram Gaganasadrisham Meghavarnam Shubhangam
Lakshmeekaantam Kamalanayanam Yogibhir Dhyaanagamyam
Vande Vishnum Bhavabhayaharam Sarvalokaikanatham
content.meaning: I bow to Vishnu, who has a peaceful form, who reclines on the serpent Shesha, from whose navel springs the lotus, the Lord of gods. He who is the support of the universe, vast as the sky, dark as clouds, with auspicious limbs, beloved of Lakshmi, lotus-eyed, attainable through meditation by yogis, the remover of the fear of worldly existence, the sole Lord of all worlds.
content.transliteration:
Śāntākāraṃ Bhujagaśayanaṃ Padmanābhaṃ Sureśaṃ
Viśvādhāraṃ Gaganasadṛśaṃ Meghavarṇaṃ Śubhāṅgaṃ
Lakṣmīkāntaṃ Kamalanayanaṃ Yogibhir Dhyānagamyaṃ
Vande Viṣṇuṃ Bhavabhayaharaṃ Sarvalokaikānātham

content.shloka:
Amritamshudbhavo Bhanuh Shashabinduh Sureshvarah
Aushadham Jagatah Setuh Satyadharma Paraakramah
content.meaning: He from whom the nectar-rayed moon was born, the luminous one, marked like the moon, the Lord of the gods, the medicine of the world, the bridge of the universe, whose valor is truth and righteousness.
content.transliteration:
Amṛtāṃśudbhavo Bhānuḥ Śaśabinduḥ Sureśvaraḥ
Auṣadhaṃ Jagataḥ Setuḥ Satyadharma Parākramaḥ

content.shloka:
Naama Sankeertanam Yasya Sarva Paapa Pranashanam
Pranamo Duhkhashamanas Tam Namami Harim Param
content.meaning: He whose name-chanting destroys all sins, whose prostration removes all sorrows — I bow to that Supreme Lord Hari.
content.transliteration:
Nāma Saṅkīrtanaṃ Yasya Sarva Pāpa Praṇāśanam
Praṇāmo Duḥkhaśamanas Taṃ Namāmi Hariṃ Param

content.shloka:
Jatataveegalajjala Pravahapavitasthale
Galeavalambya Lambitam Bhujangatungamaalikaam
Damaddamaddamaddama Ninaaadavaddamaarvayam
Chakaar Chandtaandavam Tanotu Nah Shivah Shivam
content.meaning: From whose matted hair flows the holy river in torrents, purifying all it touches, upon whose neck hangs a serpent like a grand garland, who dances the fierce Tandava to the rhythmic beat of the damaru drum — may that Shiva bestow auspiciousness upon us.
content.transliteration:
Jaṭāṭavīgalajjalā Pravāhapāvitasthale
Gale'valambya Lambitāṃ Bhujaṅgatuṅgamālikām
Ḍamadḍamadḍamadḍama Nināḍavadḍamarvayaṃ
Cakāra Caṇḍatāṇḍavaṃ Tanotu Naḥ Śivaḥ Śivam

content.shloka:
Jata Kataha Sambhrama Bhramanilimpa Nirjhari
Vilolaveechi Vallaree Viraajamana Moordhani
Dhagaddhagaddhagajjvala Lalata Pattapaavake
Kishorachandrashekhare Ratih Pratikshnam Mama
content.meaning: Upon whose head the celestial Ganga wanders in bewildering streams through the dense matted locks, whose forehead blazes with the fire of the third eye like a series of flames, and who wears the crescent moon as a crown — may my love for that Lord increase every moment.
content.transliteration:
Jaṭākaṭāha Sambhrama Bhramanilimpa Nirjharī
Vilolāvīci Vallarī Virājamāna Mūrdhani
Dhagaddhagaddhagajjvalā Lalāṭa Paṭṭapāvake
Kiśoracandrāśekhare Ratiḥ Pratikṣaṇaṃ Mama

content.shloka:
Dharadharendranandini Vilasabandhubandhura
Sphuradigantasantati Pramodamaanamanaase
Kripaakaataakshadhorani Nirudhadurdharaapadi
Kvachidigambare Manovinodametuvastuni
content.meaning: May my mind find delight in the Lord who rejoices with the daughter of the mountain king, whose radiance extends to all directions, whose compassionate glance removes the most terrible calamities, and who is clad in the directions themselves.
content.transliteration:
Dharādharendranandini Vilāsabandhubandhura
Sphuradigantasantatī Pramodamānamānase
Kṛpākaṭākṣadhoraṇī Niruddhadurdharāpadi
Kvaciddigambare Manovinodametuvastuni

content.shloka:
Jata Bhujanaga Pingala Sphurat Phanamaani Prabha
Kadamba Kunkuma Dravapralipta Digvadhumukhe
Madaandha Sindhura Sphurat Tvaguttareeyamedure
Mano Vinodamadbhutam Bibhartu Bhoota Bhartari
content.meaning: May my mind find wonderful delight in the Lord of all beings, from whose serpent-adorned matted hair emanates a yellowish radiance like saffron, whose directions are anointed with kadamba and kumkum, and who wears the skin of a mighty intoxicated elephant as his upper garment.
content.transliteration:
Jaṭā Bhujaṅga Piṅgala Sphurat Phaṇāmaṇi Prabhā
Kadamba Kuṅkuma Dravapralipta Digvadhūmukhe
Madāndha Sindhura Sphurat Tvaguttarīyamedure
Mano Vinodamadbhutaṃ Bibhartu Bhūta Bhartari

content.shloka:
Sahasra Lochana Prabhritya Sheshalekha Shekhara
Prasoonadhooli Dhorani Vidhoosaranghripa Peethabhooh
Bhujangaraaja Maalaya Nibaddhajaatajootaka
Shriyai Chiraya Jaayatam Chakora Bandhushekharah
content.meaning: He at whose feet the thousand-eyed Indra and other gods bow, covering his feet with flower pollen, whose matted locks are bound by the king of serpents, and who wears the moon as a crest jewel like a friend of the chakora bird — may He grant us lasting prosperity.
content.transliteration:
Sahasra Locana Prabhṛtya Śeṣalekha Śekhara
Prasūnadhūli Dhoraṇī Vidhūsarāṅghripīṭhabhūḥ
Bhujaṅgarāja Mālayā Nibaddhajaṭājūṭaka
Śriyai Cirāya Jāyatāṃ Cakora Bandhuśekharaḥ

content.shloka:
Imam Hi Nityameva Muktamuttamottamam Stavam
Pathan Smaran Bruhannaro Vishuddhimeti Santatam
Hare Gurau Subhaktimashu Yaati Naanyathaa Gatim
Vimohanam Hi Dehinaam Sushankarasya Chintanam
content.meaning: He who reads, remembers, and recites this supreme and eternal hymn always attains purity. He swiftly gains deep devotion to Lord Shiva, the great guru, and finds no other refuge. Indeed, the contemplation of the auspicious Shankara removes the delusion of all embodied beings.
content.transliteration:
Imaṃ Hi Nityameva Muktamuttamottamaṃ Stavaṃ
Paṭhan Smaran Bṛhannaro Viśuddhimeti Santatam
Hare Gurau Subhaktimāśu Yāti Nānyathā Gatiṃ
Vimohanaṃ Hi Dehināṃ Suśaṅkarasya Cintanam

content.shloka:
Ayi Girinandini Nanditamedini Vishvavinodini Nandinoote
Girivaravindhya Shirodhinivaasini Vishnuvilaasini Jishnunoote
Bhagavati He Shitikanthakoottumbini Bhoorikottumbini Bhoorikrite
Jaya Jaya He Mahishasuramardini Ramyakapardini Shailasute
content.meaning: O daughter of the mountain, who delights the earth, who entertains the universe, O celebrated one! You who dwell on the peak of the great Vindhya mountain, the playful consort of Vishnu, O celebrated victorious one! O Goddess, wife of the blue-throated Shiva, of vast family, of great deeds — Victory, victory to You, O slayer of Mahishasura, with beautiful braided hair, O daughter of the mountain!
content.transliteration:
Ayi Girinandini Nanditamedini Viśvavinodini Nandinūte
Girivaravindhya Śirodhinivasini Viṣṇuvilāsini Jiṣṇunūte
Bhagavati He Śitikāṇṭhakuṭumbini Bhūrikuṭumbini Bhūrikṛte
Jaya Jaya He Mahiṣāsuramardini Ramyakapardini Śailasute

content.shloka:
Ayi Suvarnavarnanandeeshailadhanvi Dhanurjvara
Kshitibhubhritikutumba Kumaariekutumbini
Lakshmeedharasthala Chiranta Ruchah Kuchabhara
Jaya Jaya He Mahishasuramardini Ramyakapardini Shailasute
content.meaning: O golden-complexioned one, You who wield the bow that causes fever to the enemies, You who are the family deity of the earth's kings, the mother of Kumari! Your chest bears the mark of Lakshmi with eternal radiance — Victory, victory to You, O slayer of Mahishasura, with beautiful braided hair, O daughter of the mountain!
content.transliteration:
Ayi Suvarṇavarṇānandīśailadhanvi Dhanurjvara
Kṣitibhubhṛtikuṭumba Kumārīkuṭumbinī
Lakṣmīdhārasthala Ciranta Rucaḥ Kucabhāra
Jaya Jaya He Mahiṣāsuramardini Ramyakapardini Śailasute

content.shloka:
Ayi Nija Hugrin Bala Vikriti Vishishta Shila Nika
Tala Vinoda Yogini Yogaanandini Maddure
Aruna Madhura Chandana Chandana Rasa Vigalit Lochan
Jaya Jaya He Mahishasuramardini Ramyakapardini Shailasute
content.meaning: O You who are accomplished in the unique art of wielding your own weapons, O Yogini who delights in the dance of combat, immersed in the bliss of yoga! Your eyes are moistened with the sweet reddish fragrance of sandalwood — Victory, victory to You, O slayer of Mahishasura, with beautiful braided hair, O daughter of the mountain!
content.transliteration:
Ayi Nija Huṅkṛti Bala Vikṛti Viśiṣṭa Śīla Nika
Tāla Vinoda Yoginī Yogānandini Maddure
Aruṇa Madhura Candana Candana Rasa Vigalita Locana
Jaya Jaya He Mahiṣāsuramardini Ramyakapardini Śailasute

content.shloka:
Ayi Shataguna Vikhyaata Mahaashakti Shatardha Dhiishvarini
Durita Dureeha Duraa Shayadurmata Shamani Ratnaprabhaa
Dushi Krita Duhitre Duraadharashadurma Dahordinate
Jaya Jaya He Mahishasuramardini Ramyakapardini Shailasute
content.meaning: O renowned one of hundredfold powers, the sovereign wielding great force in hundreds of ways! You who remove sins, evil intentions, and wicked thoughts, radiant like a jewel! O destroyer of the arrogant and the ill-intentioned — Victory, victory to You, O slayer of Mahishasura, with beautiful braided hair, O daughter of the mountain!
content.transliteration:
Ayi Śataguṇa Vikhyāta Mahāśakti Śatārdha Dhīśvarī
Durita Durīha Durā Śayadurmata Śamani Ratnaprabhā
Duṣṭi Kṛta Durhṛde Durādhara Śadurma Dahordinate
Jaya Jaya He Mahiṣāsuramardini Ramyakapardini Śailasute

content.shloka:
Ayi Shumbha Nishumbha Mahishahava Taarpita Bhujadanda
Aneekadhara Pingala Sarpata Vaahana Mardini
Naraayanee Namostute Naraanganaa Svabhavini
Jaya Jaya He Mahishasuramardini Ramyakapardini Shailasute
content.meaning: O You whose mighty arms were engaged in the great battle against Shumbha, Nishumbha, and Mahishasura, O destroyer who rides serpents and crushes armies! O Narayani, we bow to You, O one who embodies the essence of divine feminine nature — Victory, victory to You, O slayer of Mahishasura, with beautiful braided hair, O daughter of the mountain!
content.transliteration:
Ayi Śumbha Niśumbha Mahiṣāhava Tarpita Bhujadaṇḍa
Anīkadhāra Piṅgala Sarpaṭa Vāhana Mardinī
Nārāyaṇī Namostute Narāṅganā Svabhāvinī
Jaya Jaya He Mahiṣāsuramardini Ramyakapardini Śailasute

content.shloka:
Ayi Nijajanmabhoo Sphura Digantale Krishnamanohari
Praviralaragha Chaaru Vilasata Mukhatara Viram
Surabhi Meruve Gajahantave Shriyam Kurute
Jaya Jaya He Mahishasuramardini Ramyakapardini Shailasute
content.meaning: O You whose birthplace illuminates all directions, enchanting like Krishna, whose beautiful face shines with rare and lovely ornaments, who bestows prosperity upon the divine Mount Meru and destroys the elephant-demon — Victory, victory to You, O slayer of Mahishasura, with beautiful braided hair, O daughter of the mountain!
content.transliteration:
Ayi Nijajanmabhū Sphura Digantale Kṛṣṇamanohari
Praviralarāgha Cāru Vilasata Mukhatara Vīraṃ
Surabhi Meruve Gajahantave Śriyaṃ Kurute
Jaya Jaya He Mahiṣāsuramardini Ramyakapardini Śailasute

content.shloka:
Angam Hare Pulakabhooshanamaashrayantee
Bhringaanganeva Mukulaabharanam Tamaalam
Angikriyaasaam Mayi Kaantikaam Kataksha Dhaarayaa
Aamiiliteeksha Mamiisha Kalasindhu Kanyaa
content.meaning: O daughter of the milky ocean! Like a female bee seeking a budding tamala tree, You cling to the body of Lord Hari, adorning Him with divine goosebumps of joy. Please bestow upon me Your gracious side-glance with half-closed beautiful eyes.
content.transliteration:
Aṅgaṃ Hare Pulakabhūṣaṇamāśrayantī
Bhṛṅgāṅganeva Mukulābharaṇaṃ Tamālam
Aṅgīkṛtāsām Mayi Kāntikāṃ Kaṭākṣa Dhārayā
Āmīlitekṣa Mamīśa Kalāsindhu Kanyā

content.shloka:
Bahvantare Madhujith Shritakaustubhe Ya
Haaraavaleeva Harineelamayi Vibhaati
Kaamapradata Bhagavat Yapi Girijaa Saandraam
Aamiiliteeksha Mamiisha Kalasindhu Kanyaa
content.meaning: O daughter of the milky ocean! You shine on the broad chest of Lord Vishnu, the slayer of Madhu, alongside the Kaustubha gem, like a necklace of sapphires. O bestower of all desires, O Goddess — please cast Your compassionate glance upon me with half-closed eyes.
content.transliteration:
Bahvantare Madhujitaḥ Śritakaustubhe Yā
Hārāvalīva Hariṇīlamayī Vibhāti
Kāmapradā Bhagavatī Api Girijā Sāndrāṃ
Āmīlitekṣa Mamīśa Kalāsindhu Kanyā

content.shloka:
Vishnoh Sthitaikakanakadhara Tatvadhanye
Vishtaaritam Nitamapi Kripaalavaalaam
Aameelanasya Paripoorna Dayaadhaaraam
Aamiiliteeksha Mamiisha Kalasindhu Kanyaa
content.meaning: O daughter of the milky ocean, Your sole abode is with Vishnu, and You are the golden stream of wealth itself. You extend Your grace like a creeper of mercy; Your half-closed eyes pour forth complete compassion. Please bless me with that glance.
content.transliteration:
Viṣṇoḥ Sthitaikakanakadhāra Tatvadhanye
Viṣṭāritaṃ Nitamapi Kṛpālavālāṃ
Āmīlanasya Paripūrṇa Dayādhārāṃ
Āmīlitekṣa Mamīśa Kalāsindhu Kanyā

content.shloka:
Ameelita Aksha Adhigamya Mudaa Mukundam
Aanandakandamalakam Paramaadam Aadhyam
Alokaye Bhaveyameesah Tanoomidaanam
Aamiiliteeksha Mamiisha Kalasindhu Kanyaa
content.meaning: O daughter of the milky ocean! With half-closed eyes You lovingly gaze upon Mukunda, the source of bliss, the pure, supreme, and primordial one. May I behold that divine form of Yours now. Please grant me Your gracious glance.
content.transliteration:
Amīlita Akṣa Adhigamya Mudā Mukunda
Ānandakandamalaka Paramādam Ādyam
Ālokaye Bhaveyamīśa Tanūmidānaṃ
Āmīlitekṣa Mamīśa Kalāsindhu Kanyā

content.shloka:
Ishtaa Vishishtamatayopi Yasya Bhajanti
Naivaa Asheesh Twadumangalataam Mamaapi
Kaamapradata Kanakadhaarataam Pradiishya
Smitapravaahamadhuriipratibheeshwareeha
content.meaning: Even the most distinguished and wise ones worship You eagerly, yet none remain devoid of Your blessings. O bestower of desires, please grant me that golden stream of Your grace, O Goddess whose flowing smile radiates intoxicating sweetness.
content.transliteration:
Iṣṭā Viśiṣṭamatayopi Yasya Bhajanti
Naivāśeṣa Tvadamaṅgalatāṃ Mamāpi
Kāmapradā Kanakādhāratāṃ Pradīśya
Smitapravāhamadhurīpratibhīśvarīha

content.shloka:
Dadyaaddayaanupavano Dravinaambudhaaraam
Asminnakinchanavihangashishau Vishanney
Dushkarmikahmamiha Vistaratu Pradoshey
Aamiiliteeksha Mamiisha Kalasindhu Kanyaa
content.meaning: O daughter of the milky ocean! May the wind of Your compassion shower a rain of wealth upon this destitute bird-like creature who is distressed. Though I am a sinner, may Your grace expand upon me in this time of darkness. Please bless me with Your half-closed merciful glance.
content.transliteration:
Dadyāddayānupavano Draviṇāmbudhārāṃ
Asminnakiñcanavihāṅgaśiśau Viṣaṇṇe
Duṣkarmikāhmamihā Vistaratu Pradoṣe
Āmīlitekṣa Mamīśa Kalāsindhu Kanyā

content.shloka:
Brahma Muraari Suraarchita Lingam
Nirmala Bhashita Shobhita Lingam
Janmaja Dukha Vinaashaka Lingam
Tat Pranamaami Sadashiva Lingam
content.meaning: I bow before that Sadashiva Linga, which is worshipped by Brahma, Vishnu, and all the gods, which shines with pure and radiant splendor, and which destroys the sorrows born of repeated births.
content.transliteration:
Brahma Murāri Surārcita Liṅgaṃ
Nirmala Bhāṣita Śobhita Liṅgaṃ
Janmaja Duḥkha Vināśaka Liṅgaṃ
Tat Praṇamāmi Sadāśiva Liṅgam

content.shloka:
Devamuni Pravaraarchita Lingam
Kaamadaham Karunaakara Lingam
Raavana Darpa Vinaashana Lingam
Tat Pranamaami Sadashiva Lingam
content.meaning: I bow before that Sadashiva Linga, which is worshipped by the foremost gods and sages, which burns away desires, which is the abode of compassion, and which destroyed the pride of Ravana.
content.transliteration:
Devamuni Pravarārcita Liṅgaṃ
Kāmadahaṃ Karuṇākara Liṅgaṃ
Rāvaṇa Darpa Vināśana Liṅgaṃ
Tat Praṇamāmi Sadāśiva Liṅgam

content.shloka:
Sarva Sugandhi Sulepita Lingam
Buddhi Vivaardhana Kaarana Lingam
Siddha Suraasura Vandita Lingam
Tat Pranamaami Sadashiva Lingam
content.meaning: I bow before that Sadashiva Linga, which is anointed with all fragrant substances, which is the cause of the growth of wisdom and intellect, and which is venerated by the Siddhas, gods, and demons alike.
content.transliteration:
Sarva Sugandhi Sulepita Liṅgaṃ
Buddhi Vivārdhana Kāraṇa Liṅgaṃ
Siddha Surāsura Vandita Liṅgaṃ
Tat Praṇamāmi Sadāśiva Liṅgam

content.shloka:
Kanaka Mahaamani Bhooshita Lingam
Phanipati Veshtita Shobhita Lingam
Daksha Suyagnya Vinaashana Lingam
Tat Pranamaami Sadashiva Lingam
content.meaning: I bow before that Sadashiva Linga, which is adorned with gold and great jewels, which shines beautifully encircled by the king of serpents, and which destroyed the sacrifice of Daksha.
content.transliteration:
Kanaka Mahāmaṇi Bhūṣita Liṅgaṃ
Phaṇipati Veṣṭita Śobhita Liṅgaṃ
Dakṣa Suyajña Vināśana Liṅgaṃ
Tat Praṇamāmi Sadāśiva Liṅgam

content.shloka:
Kumkuma Chandana Lepita Lingam
Pankaja Haara Sushobhita Lingam
Sanchita Paapa Vinaashana Lingam
Tat Pranamaami Sadashiva Lingam
content.meaning: I bow before that Sadashiva Linga, which is smeared with kumkum and sandalwood paste, which is beautifully adorned with garlands of lotuses, and which destroys the accumulated sins of devotees.
content.transliteration:
Kuṅkuma Candana Lepita Liṅgaṃ
Paṅkaja Hāra Suśobhita Liṅgaṃ
Sañcita Pāpa Vināśana Liṅgaṃ
Tat Praṇamāmi Sadāśiva Liṅgam

content.shloka:
Lingashtakam Idam Punyam Yah Patheth Shiva Sannidhou
Shivalokam Avaapnoti Shivena Saha Modate
content.meaning: Whoever recites this sacred Lingashtakam in the presence of Lord Shiva attains the abode of Shiva and rejoices in the company of Lord Shiva for eternity.
content.transliteration:
Liṅgāṣṭakam Idaṃ Puṇyaṃ Yaḥ Paṭhet Śiva Sannidhau
Śivalokam Āvāpnoti Śivena Saha Modate

content.shloka:
Achyutam Keshavam Rama Narayanam
Krishna Damodaram Vasudevam Harim
Shreedharam Madhavam Gopikaa Vallabham
Jaanakee Naayakam Ramachandram Bhaje
content.meaning: I worship Achyuta, Keshava, Rama, and Narayana; Krishna, Damodara, Vasudeva, and Hari; Shridhara, Madhava, the beloved of the Gopis; and Ramachandra, the Lord of Janaki.
content.transliteration:
Acyutaṃ Keśavaṃ Rāma Nārāyaṇaṃ
Kṛṣṇa Dāmodaraṃ Vāsudevaṃ Harim
Śrīdharaṃ Mādhavaṃ Gopikā Vallabhaṃ
Jānakī Nāyakaṃ Rāmacandraṃ Bhaje

content.shloka:
Achyutam Keshavam Satyabhaamadhavam
Maadhavam Shreedharam Radhikaaradhitam
Indiramandiram Chetasaa Sundaram
Devakeenandanam Nandajam Sandadhe
content.meaning: I hold in my heart Achyuta, Keshava, the Lord of Satyabhama, Madhava, Shridhara, the one worshipped by Radhika, the beautiful abode of Lakshmi in the heart, the joy of Devaki, the son of Nanda.
content.transliteration:
Acyutaṃ Keśavaṃ Satyabhāmādhavaṃ
Mādhavaṃ Śrīdharaṃ Rādhikārādhitam
Indirāmandiraṃ Cetasā Sundaraṃ
Devakīnandanaṃ Nandajaṃ Sandadhe

content.shloka:
Vishnave Krishnaye Govindaaya Namo
Maadhavaaya Cha Vidmahe Naarayanam
Vishnorevahi Tvam Padmanabham Param
Dhyaayaami Devam Vasudevam Sadaa
content.meaning: Salutations to Vishnu, Krishna, and Govinda. We know Madhava and meditate upon Narayana. You are indeed Vishnu, the supreme Padmanabha. I always meditate upon Lord Vasudeva.
content.transliteration:
Viṣṇave Kṛṣṇaye Govindāya Namo
Mādhavāya Ca Vidmahe Nārāyaṇam
Viṣṇorevahi Tvaṃ Padmanābhaṃ Paraṃ
Dhyāyāmi Devaṃ Vāsudevaṃ Sadā

content.shloka:
Vasudeva Sutam Devam Kamsa Chaanoora Mardanam
Devakee Paramaanandam Krishnam Vande Jagadgurum
content.meaning: I bow to Krishna, the son of Vasudeva, the divine one who slew the demons Kamsa and Chanura, the supreme bliss of Devaki, the guru of the entire universe.
content.transliteration:
Vasudeva Sutaṃ Devaṃ Kaṃsa Cāṇūra Mardanam
Devakī Paramānandaṃ Kṛṣṇaṃ Vande Jagadgurum

content.shloka:
Krishnaaya Vasudevaaya Devakeenandanaaya Cha
Nandagopakulaanandaaya Govindaaya Namo Namah
content.meaning: Salutations again and again to Krishna, Vasudeva, the son of Devaki, the joy of Nanda's cowherd clan, and to Govinda.
content.transliteration:
Kṛṣṇāya Vāsudevāya Devakīnandanāya Ca
Nandagopākulānandāya Govindāya Namo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Namo Brahmanya Devaaya Go Braahmana Hitaaya Cha
Jagaddhitaaya Krishnaaya Govindaaya Namo Namah
content.meaning: Salutations to the Lord of the Brahmins, the benefactor of cows and Brahmins. Repeated salutations to Krishna, the benefactor of the entire universe, to Govinda.
content.transliteration:
Namo Brahmaṇya Devāya Go Brāhmaṇa Hitāya Ca
Jagaddhitāya Kṛṣṇāya Govindāya Namo Namaḥ

content.shloka:
Mudaakaraattha Modakam Sadaa Vimuktisaadhakam
Kalaadharaavatasmakam Vilaasalokrakshakam
Anaayakaikanaayakam Vinaashitebha Daityakam
Nataashubhaashu Naashakam Namaami Taam Vinaayakam
content.meaning: I salute that Vinayaka who joyfully holds a modaka sweet in his hand, who is always the bestower of liberation, who wears the crescent moon, who protects the world with playful grace, who is the sole leader of the leaderless, who destroyed the elephant demon, and who swiftly destroys the misfortunes of those who bow to him.
content.transliteration:
Mudākarātta Modakaṃ Sadā Vimuktisādhakam
Kalādharāvataṃsakaṃ Vilāsilokarakṣakam
Anāyakaikanāyakaṃ Vināśitebha Daityakam
Natāśubhāśu Nāśakaṃ Namāmi Taṃ Vināyakam

content.shloka:
Natetaraati Bheekaram Navoditaarka Bhaasvaram
Namaatsuraari Nirjaram Natadhikaapa Duddharam
Sureeshvaram Nidhiishvaram Gajeeshvaram Ganeeshvaram
Maheeshvaram Tamaashraye Paraatparam Nirantharam
content.meaning: He who is terrifying to those who do not bow, radiant like the newly risen sun, worshipped by gods and enemies of demons, who uplifts the devotees from their calamities. He who is the Lord of gods, Lord of wealth, Lord of elephants, Lord of the Ganas, and the great Lord — I take refuge in that supreme being, forever.
content.transliteration:
Natetarāti Bhīkaraṃ Navoditārka Bhāsvaraṃ
Namatsurāri Nirjaraṃ Natādhikāpa Duddharam
Sureśvaraṃ Nidhīśvaraṃ Gajeśvaraṃ Gaṇeśvaraṃ
Maheśvaraṃ Tamāśraye Parātparaṃ Nirantaram

content.shloka:
Samasta Loka Shankaram Nirasta Daityakunjaram
Daredarodaram Varam Vare Bhavaktimashraye
Karaambujaprayochitam Sadaasthitam Padaambuje
Kareeh Kutaaritam Vaaram Vareenaamakaram Bhaje
content.meaning: He who brings auspiciousness to all the worlds, who has cast away the elephant demon, whose large belly is magnificent, in whom the devotees of the best Lord take refuge. He whose lotus hands are always ready to bless, whose feet are lotus-like, who tore apart the elephant demon — I worship that foremost bestower of boons.
content.transliteration:
Samasta Loka Śaṅkaraṃ Nirasta Daityakuñjaraṃ
Daredarodaraṃ Varaṃ Vare Bhavaktimāśraye
Karāmbujaprayocitaṃ Sadāsthitaṃ Padāmbuje
Karīh Kuṭāritaṃ Vāraṃ Varīṇāmākaraṃ Bhaje

content.shloka:
Niteenireetatam Mahaaahatee Swaroopakam Param
Tvadeeya Padapankajam Namaami Deva Naayakam
Jagadvichitra Nirmitam Vikaaraheena Maatulam
Hridantare Nirantharam Vasantameva Yoginaam
content.meaning: O supreme one of eternal and infinite true form! I bow to Your lotus feet, O leader of the gods. You who have created this wonderful and diverse universe, who are unchanging and matchless — You dwell eternally in the hearts of yogis.
content.transliteration:
Nitīnirītataṃ Mahāhati Svarūpakaṃ Paraṃ
Tvadīya Padapaṅkajaṃ Namāmi Deva Nāyakam
Jagadvicitra Nirmitaṃ Vikārahīna Mātulaṃ
Hṛdantare Nirantaraṃ Vasantameva Yoginām

content.shloka:
Jagatkaarana Madbhutam Chidaanandaikabhooshitam
Paraatparam Niranjanam Niraakaaram Ganeeshvaram
Samastadarshanaadishu Samasta Vaidikeshu Cha
Sadaa Viruddhaheena Buddhi Bhooshitam Bhajeham
content.meaning: He who is the wondrous cause of the universe, adorned with pure consciousness and bliss alone, the supreme beyond the supreme, untainted, formless Lord of the Ganas. He who is present in all philosophies and all Vedic traditions, always adorned with wisdom free from contradiction — I worship Him.
content.transliteration:
Jagatkāraṇa Madbhutaṃ Cidānandaikabhūṣitam
Parātparaṃ Nirañjanaṃ Nirākāraṃ Gaṇeśvaram
Samastadarśanādiṣu Samasta Vaidikeṣu Ca
Sadā Viruddhaheena Buddhi Bhūṣitaṃ Bhajeham

content.shloka:
Pancharatnamidham Punyam Yah Pathet Ganasannidhau
Kaveeshvaro Bhavetsheegram Vidyaavaan Dhanavaan Bhavet
content.meaning: Whoever recites these five jewels of hymns in the presence of Lord Ganesha will swiftly become a master poet, will become learned and wealthy.
content.transliteration:
Pañcaratnamidaṃ Puṇyaṃ Yaḥ Paṭhet Gaṇasannidhau
Kavīśvaro Bhavetśīghraṃ Vidyāvān Dhanavān Bhavet

content.shloka:
Charitam Raghunaathasya Shata Koti Pravistaram
Ekaikamaksharam Pumsaam Mahapaataka Naashanam
content.meaning: The story of Lord Raghunatha extends over a hundred crore verses. Each and every syllable of it is capable of destroying the greatest sins of mankind.
content.transliteration:
Caritaṃ Raghunāthasya Śata Koṭi Pravistaram
Ekaikamakṣaraṃ Puṃsāṃ Mahāpātaka Nāśanam

content.shloka:
Dhyaayedaajaanubhahu Vishvapavanaarjavanaashanam
Sarva Siddhisampannam Sitaapathimachintyam Ajeyyam Raaghavam
Uttamam Dharmagatim Shobhaa Kaarakam Ramacharanam Prapadye
content.meaning: I meditate upon Rama whose arms extend to His knees, the purifier of the universe, the destroyer of the wicked, endowed with all powers, the Lord of Sita, the inconceivable, the invincible Raghava. I take refuge at the feet of Rama, the supreme one, the embodiment of Dharma, the cause of all beauty.
content.transliteration:
Dhyāyedājānubāhu Viśvapāvanārjavānāśanaṃ
Sarva Siddhisampannaṃ Sītāpatimachintyam Ajeyaṃ Rāghavaṃ
Uttamaṃ Dharmagatiṃ Śobhā Kārakaṃ Rāmacaraṇaṃ Prapadye

content.shloka:
Raamo Raakshasa Maareetim Raamoh Loka Paraayanam
Raajendram Satyasandham Cha Raamam Dasharathaatmajam
content.meaning: Rama, the slayer of the demon Maricha; Rama, the supreme refuge of all the worlds; the king among kings, ever truthful — that Rama, the son of Dasharatha.
content.transliteration:
Rāmo Rākṣasa Mārītaṃ Rāmoḥ Loka Parāyaṇam
Rājendraṃ Satyasandhaṃ Ca Rāmaṃ Daśarathātmajam

content.shloka:
Raamah Shirah Paatu Sada Raghunaathah Phaalam Mama
Raaghavah Pau Nethre Me Vishvamitrapriyo Mukhham
Jiivhaam Vidyanidhih Paatu Kanthe Paatu Dhaneshvarah
content.meaning: May Rama always protect my head, may Raghunatha protect my forehead. May Raghava protect my eyes, may the beloved of Vishvamitra protect my face. May the treasury of knowledge protect my tongue, and may the Lord of wealth protect my throat.
content.transliteration:
Rāmaḥ Śiraḥ Pātu Sadā Raghunāthaḥ Phālaṃ Mama
Rāghavaḥ Pātu Netre Me Viśvāmitrapriyaḥ Mukham
Jihvāṃ Vidyānidhiḥ Pātu Kaṇṭhe Pātu Dhaneśvaraḥ

content.shloka:
Neelaambujashyaamalatam Nitaambujaniveshitam
Vaama Ankagataa Seetaa Raama Paatu Sakudalaam
Ramena Abhihatam Yaatu Rakshsham Rameena Lokaschyutam
Rama Dwesha Vimuktaanaam Raamaanugatirbhaveth
content.meaning: He who is dark-complexioned like a blue lotus, who is established in eternal purity, with Sita seated on His left — may Rama protect all with His entire family. May all evil be destroyed by Rama, may the world be sustained by Rama. For those free from hatred of Rama, may they attain the path of Rama.
content.transliteration:
Nīlāmbujaśyāmalataṃ Nitāmbujaniveśitam
Vāma Aṅkagatā Sītā Rāma Pātu Sakuṭalāṃ
Rāmeṇa Abhihataṃ Yātu Rakṣaśaṃ Rāmeṇa Lokaścyutaṃ
Rāma Dveṣa Vimuktānāṃ Rāmānugatir Bhavet

content.shloka:
Raamaaya Raamabhadraaya Raamachandraaya Vedbase
Raghunaathaaya Naathaaya Seetaayaah Pataye Namah
Shreeramo Jayaraamah Jaya Jayaramah Jayaramah
Raamachandro Vijayate Raamoramah Sadaa Bhaje
content.meaning: Salutations to Rama, Ramabhadra, Ramachandra, the knower of the Vedas, Raghunatha, the Lord, the husband of Sita. Sri Rama, victorious Rama, all glory to Rama! Ramachandra is ever triumphant — I always worship that blissful Rama.
content.transliteration:
Rāmāya Rāmabhadrāya Rāmacandrāya Vedhase
Raghunāthāya Nāthāya Sītāyāḥ Pataye Namaḥ
Śrīrāmo Jayarāmaḥ Jaya Jayarāmaḥ Jayarāmaḥ
Rāmacandro Vijayate Rāmorāmaḥ Sadā Bhaje

content.shloka:
Goshtapadee Krita Vaaraashim Mashakee Krita Raakshasam
Raamayana Mahaamaalaa Ratnam Vande Anilatmajam
content.meaning: I salute the son of the wind god, who crossed the ocean as if it were a puddle in a cow's hoof-print, who crushed the demons like mosquitoes, and who is the greatest jewel in the garland of the Ramayana.
content.transliteration:
Goṣṭapadī Kṛta Vārāśim Maśakī Kṛta Rākṣasam
Rāmāyaṇa Mahāmālā Ratnaṃ Vande Anilātmajam

content.shloka:
Atulita Baladaamam Hemashailaaabha Deham
Danuja Vana Krishaanum Jnaaninaaam Agraganyam
Sakala Guna Nidhaanam Vaanaraanaam Adhisham
Raghupati Priya Bhaktam Vaatajatam Namaami
content.meaning: I bow to the son of the wind, who has incomparable strength, whose body shines like a mountain of gold, who is a fire to the forest of demons, foremost among the wise, the treasure-house of all virtues, the chief of the monkeys, and the beloved devotee of Lord Rama.
content.transliteration:
Atulita Baladāmam Hemaśailābha Deham
Danuja Vana Kṛśānum Jñānināṃ Agragaṇyam
Sakala Guṇa Nidhānaṃ Vānarāṇām Adhīśam
Raghupati Priya Bhaktaṃ Vātajātaṃ Namāmi

content.shloka:
Anjaneya Matipaataalapaatalam
Kshitikanthakaashtha Vibhajatkapeeshvaram
Dashakantha Dordandavipaatagarvitam
Pranamamyaham Hanumantam Ashugam
content.meaning: I bow to Hanuman, the swift one, son of Anjana, whose intellect reaches the netherworld, who is the mighty lord of monkeys capable of splitting the earth, and who humbled the pride of the ten-headed Ravana's powerful arms.
content.transliteration:
Añjaneya Matipātālapātalaṃ
Kṣitīkaṇṭhakāstha Vibhajakapeśvaram
Daśakaṇṭha Dordaṇḍavipātagarvitam
Praṇamāmyahaṃ Hanūmantam Āśugam

content.shloka:
Ullanghya Sindho Salilam Saleelam
Yah Shoka Vahnim Janakaa Tmajaayaah
Aadaaya Tenaiva Dadaaha Lankaam
Namaami Tam Praanjaliraanjaneyam
content.meaning: I salute with folded hands that son of Anjana, who playfully leapt over the ocean waters, who discovered the fire of sorrow burning in Sita, daughter of Janaka, and then with that very fire burned down Lanka.
content.transliteration:
Ullaṅghya Sindho Salilaṃ Salīlaṃ
Yaḥ Śoka Vahniṃ Janakātmajāyāḥ
Ādāya Tenaiva Dadāha Laṅkāṃ
Namāmi Taṃ Prāñjalirāñjaneyam

content.shloka:
Manojavam Maaruta Tulyavegam
Jitendriyam Buddhimataam Varishtham
Vaataatmajam Vaanara Yoothmukhyam
Shriramadootam Sharanam Prapadye
content.meaning: I take refuge in the messenger of Lord Rama, who is swift as the mind, equal in speed to the wind, master of the senses, foremost among the intelligent, the son of the wind god, and the chief of the monkey army.
content.transliteration:
Manojavaṃ Māruta Tulyavegaṃ
Jitendriyaṃ Buddhimatāṃ Variṣṭham
Vātātmajaṃ Vānara Yūthamukhyaṃ
Śrīrāmadūtaṃ Śaraṇaṃ Prapadye

content.shloka:
Buddhir Balam Yasho Dhairyam Nirbhayatva Mrogata
Ajaatyam Vaak Patutvam Cha Hanumat Smaranaat Bhavet
content.meaning: By remembering Hanuman, one attains wisdom, strength, fame, courage, fearlessness, freedom from disease, unceasing energy, and eloquence of speech.
content.transliteration:
Buddhir Balaṃ Yaśo Dhairyaṃ Nirbhayatva Marogatā
Ajāḍyaṃ Vāk Paṭutvaṃ Ca Hanūmat Smaraṇāt Bhavet

content.shloka:
Tato Yuddha Parishraantam Samare Chintayaa Sthitam
Raavanam Chaagrato Dristvaa Yuddhaaya Samupasthitam
content.meaning: Then, seeing Rama standing exhausted on the battlefield, lost in thought, with Ravana approaching for battle, the sage Agastya came near.
content.transliteration:
Tato Yuddha Pariśrāntaṃ Samare Cintayā Sthitam
Rāvaṇaṃ Cāgrato Dṛṣṭvā Yuddhāya Samupasthitam

content.shloka:
Raashmi Mantam Samudyantam Devaasurana Maskritam
Poojayasva Vivasvantam Bhaaskaram Bhuvaneshvaram
content.meaning: Worship the rising sun, the lord of rays, saluted by gods and demons alike, the resplendent Vivasvan, the maker of light, the lord of all worlds.
content.transliteration:
Rāśmimantaṃ Samudyantaṃ Devāsura Namaskṛtam
Pūjayasva Vivasvantaṃ Bhāskaraṃ Bhuvaneśvaram

content.shloka:
Sarva Devaa Tmako Hyesha Tejasvee Rashmi Bhaavanah
Esha Devaasuraganaanlokaan Paati Gabhastibhih
content.meaning: He is the soul of all the gods, resplendent and radiant. He protects all the worlds of gods and demons with his rays.
content.transliteration:
Sarva Devātmako Hyeṣa Tejasvī Raśmibhāvanaḥ
Eṣa Devāsura Gaṇān Lokān Pāti Gabhastibhiḥ

content.shloka:
Esha Brahmaa Cha Vishnush Cha Shivah Skandah Prajaapatihi
Mahendro Dhanadah Kaalo Yamah Somo Hyapaam Patihi
content.meaning: He is Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, Skanda, and Prajapati. He is Mahendra, Kubera, Kala (time), Yama, Soma, and the lord of waters.
content.transliteration:
Eṣa Brahmā Ca Viṣṇuś Ca Śivaḥ Skandaḥ Prajāpatiḥ
Mahendro Dhanadaḥ Kālo Yamaḥ Somo Hyapāṃ Patiḥ

content.shloka:
Namasya Aaditya Hridaya Bhagavaan Aditya Poorvam
Etat Trigunya Mavrutyam Nara Naaraayano Jayati
content.meaning: Salutations to the Aditya Hridayam! The blessed Sun, primeval among the Adityas, by reciting this hymn thrice, which contains the three gunas, one attains victory like Narayana among men.
content.transliteration:
Namasya Āditya Hṛdayaṃ Bhagavān Āditya Pūrvam
Etat Triguṇya Mavṛtyaṃ Nara Nārāyaṇo Jayati

content.shloka:
Aadityanaam Namaskaaraanye Kurvanti Dine Dine
Aayuh Prajnaa Balam Veeryam Tejastesha Cha Jaayate
content.meaning: Those who offer salutations to the Sun every day gain longevity, wisdom, strength, valor, and radiance.
content.transliteration:
Ādityānāṃ Namaskārān Ye Kurvanti Dine Dine
Āyuḥ Prajñā Balaṃ Vīryaṃ Tejastēṣāṃ Ca Jāyate

content.shloka:
Shree Maataa Shree Mahaaraajnee Shreematsimhaasaneshvaree
Chidagni Kundaasambhootaa Devakaarya Samudyataa
content.meaning: She is the auspicious Mother, the great Empress, the glorious one seated on the royal throne. She was born from the fire-pit of pure consciousness and arose to fulfill the purpose of the gods.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Mātā Śrī Mahārājñī Śrīmatsiṃhāsaneśvarī
Cidagni Kuṇḍasambhūtā Devakārya Samudyatā

content.shloka:
Udyad Bhaanu Sahasraabhaa Chaturbaahusamanvitaa
Raagasvaroopapaashaadhyaa Krodhaakaaraankushojjvalaa
content.meaning: She radiates the brilliance of a thousand rising suns, possesses four arms, holds the noose of desire which is her own form, and blazes with the goad representing righteous anger.
content.transliteration:
Udyad Bhānu Sahasrābhā Caturbāhusamanvitā
Rāgasvarūpapāśāḍhyā Krodhākārāṅkuśojjvalā

content.shloka:
Manorupekshu Kodandaa Pancha Tanmaatra Saayakaa
Nijaaaruna Prabhaapoora Majjad Brahmaanda Mandalaa
content.meaning: She holds a sugarcane bow representing the mind, her arrows are the five subtle elements, and the entire cosmos is immersed in the flood of her crimson radiance.
content.transliteration:
Manorūpekṣu Kodaṇḍā Pañca Tanmātra Sāyakā
Nijāruṇa Prabhāpūra Majjad Brahmāṇḍa Maṇḍalā

content.shloka:
Champakaa Shoka Punnaaga Saugandhika Lasatkachaa
Kuruvinda Mani Shrenii Kanat Kotira Manditaa
content.meaning: Her hair is fragrant with champaka, ashoka, punnaga, and saugandhika flowers. Her crown is adorned with rows of kuruvinda gems that sparkle brilliantly.
content.transliteration:
Campakāśoka Punnāga Saugandhika Lasatkacā
Kuruvinda Maṇi Śreṇī Kanat Koṭīra Maṇḍitā

content.shloka:
Sarvamaangala Maangalye Shive Sarvaartha Saadhike
Sharanye Tryambake Gauri Naaraayani Namostute
content.meaning: O auspicious one among all that is auspicious, O consort of Shiva, O fulfiller of all desires, O refuge of all, O three-eyed Gauri, O Narayani, I bow to you.
content.transliteration:
Sarvamaṅgala Māṅgalye Śive Sarvārtha Sādhike
Śaraṇye Tryambake Gaurī Nārāyaṇī Namostute

content.shloka:
Lalitaa Ambikaa Anaadirbhaktachitta Keki Ghanaaghanaa
Samastabhakta Sukhadaa Lalitaa Ambikaa Param
content.meaning: Lalita Ambika is beginningless, she is like rain clouds to the peacocks that are the hearts of devotees. She grants happiness to all devotees. Lalita Ambika is the Supreme.
content.transliteration:
Lalitā Ambikā Anādibhaktacitta Keki Ghanāghanā
Samastabhakta Sukhadā Lalitā Ambikā Param

content.shloka:
Aham Rudrebhir Vasubhishcharaamyaham
Aadityairuta Vishvadevaih
Aham Mitraa Varunobhaa Bibharmyaham
Indragnee Aham Ashvinobhaa
content.meaning: I move with the Rudras and the Vasus. I move with the Adityas and all the gods. I support both Mitra and Varuna, and I uphold both Indra, Agni, and the twin Ashvins.
content.transliteration:
Ahaṃ Rudrebhir Vasubhiścarāmyaham
Ādityairuta Viśvadevaiḥ
Ahaṃ Mitrā Varuṇobhā Bibharmyaham
Indrāgnī Aham Aśvinobhā

content.shloka:
Aham Somam Aahanasam Bibharmyaham
Tvashtaaramuta Pooshanam Bhagam
Aham Dadhaami Dravinam Havishmate
Supraavye Yajamaanaaya Sunvate
content.meaning: I uphold Soma the destroyer of foes, I uphold Tvashta, Pushan, and Bhaga. I bestow wealth upon the one who offers oblations, who worships sincerely, and who presses the Soma juice.
content.transliteration:
Ahaṃ Somam Āhanasaṃ Bibharmyaham
Tvaṣṭāramuta Pūṣaṇaṃ Bhagam
Ahaṃ Dadhāmi Draviṇaṃ Haviṣmate
Suprāvye Yajamānāya Sunvate

content.shloka:
Aham Raashtraee Sangamanee Vasuunaam
Chikitushee Prathamaa Yajniyaanaam
Taam Maa Devaa Vyadadhuh Purutraa
Bhoori Sthaathraam Bhoori Aaveshayantiim
content.meaning: I am the sovereign queen, the gatherer of treasures, the wisest one, first among those worthy of worship. The gods have established me in many places, with many abodes, causing me to enter into many forms.
content.transliteration:
Ahaṃ Rāṣṭrī Saṅgamanī Vasūnāṃ
Cikituṣī Prathamā Yajñiyānām
Tāṃ Mā Devā Vyadadhuḥ Purutrā
Bhūri Sthātrāṃ Bhūri Āveśayantīm

content.shloka:
Mayaa So Annamatii Yo Vipashyati
Yah Praaniti Ya Eem Shrinotyuktam
Amantavo Maam Ta Upa Kshiyanti
Shruti Shrutam Shraddhivam Te Vadaami
content.meaning: Through me alone does one eat food, see, breathe, and hear what is spoken. Unaware of me, they perish. Listen, O renowned one, I speak to you what is worthy of faith.
content.transliteration:
Mayā So Annamatti Yo Vipaśyati
Yaḥ Prāṇiti Ya Īṃ Śṛṇotyuktam
Amantavo Māṃ Ta Upa Kṣiyanti
Śruti Śrutaṃ Śraddhivaṃ Te Vadāmi

content.shloka:
Ahameva Svayam Idam Vadaami
Jushtam Devebhir Uta Maanushebhih
Yam Kaamaye Tam Tamugram Krinaomi
Tam Brahmaanam Tamrishim Tam Sumedham
content.meaning: I myself declare this truth, which is cherished by gods and humans alike. Whomsoever I love, I make them mighty; I make them a sage, a seer, and one of great wisdom.
content.transliteration:
Ahameva Svayam Idaṃ Vadāmi
Juṣṭam Devebhir Uta Mānuṣebhiḥ
Yaṃ Kāmaye Taṃ Tamugram Kṛṇomi
Taṃ Brahmāṇaṃ Tamṛṣiṃ Taṃ Sumedham

content.shloka:
Aham Suve Pitaramasya Moordhan
Mama Yonirapsvantah Samudre
Tato Vi Tishthe Bhuvananu Vishvaa
Utaamum Dyaam Varshmanaa Sprishaami
content.meaning: I give birth to the father (creator) at the head of this world. My origin is in the waters, within the ocean. From there I pervade all the worlds, and I touch the distant heaven with my greatness.
content.transliteration:
Ahaṃ Suve Pitaramasya Mūrdhan
Mama Yonirapsvantaḥ Samudre
Tato Vi Tiṣṭhe Bhuvanānu Viśvā
Utāmuṃ Dyāṃ Varṣmaṇā Spṛśāmi

content.shloka:
Sahasra Sheersham Devam Vishvaaksham Vishvashambhuvam
Vishvam Naarayanam Devam Aksharam Paramam Padam
content.meaning: The Lord with a thousand heads, the all-seeing one, the benefactor of all, the all-pervading Narayana, the imperishable Supreme Being, is the highest state to be attained.
content.transliteration:
Sahasra Śīrṣaṃ Devaṃ Viśvākṣaṃ Viśvaśambhuvam
Viśvaṃ Nārāyaṇaṃ Devaṃ Akṣaraṃ Paramaṃ Padam

content.shloka:
Vishvatah Paramam Nityam Vishvam Naarayanam Harim
Vishvamevedam Purusha Stadishvaagum Sarvamvibhuh
content.meaning: Narayana is the supreme transcendental reality, eternal and all-pervading. This entire universe is indeed that Purusha (Supreme Person). He is the Lord of all, pervading everything.
content.transliteration:
Viśvataḥ Paramaṃ Nityaṃ Viśvaṃ Nārāyaṇaṃ Harim
Viśvamevedaṃ Puruṣa Tadviśvāguṃ Sarvaṃ Vibhuḥ

content.shloka:
Patim Vishvasyaatmeshvaragum Shaashvatam Shivam Achyutam
Naarayanam Mahaajneyam Vishvaatmaanam Parayanam
content.meaning: He is the Lord of the universe, the ruler of all souls, the eternal, auspicious, and infallible one. Narayana is the great one worthy of being known, the Self of the universe, the supreme refuge.
content.transliteration:
Patiṃ Viśvasyātmeśvaraguṃ Śāśvataṃ Śivam Acyutam
Nārāyaṇaṃ Mahājñeyaṃ Viśvātmānaṃ Parāyaṇam

content.shloka:
Naarayana Paraa Jyotir Aatmaa Naarayanah Parah
Naarayana Param Brahma Tattvam Naarayanah Parah
content.meaning: Narayana is the supreme light. The Self is Narayana, the supreme. Narayana is the supreme Brahman. The ultimate reality is Narayana, the supreme.
content.transliteration:
Nārāyaṇa Parā Jyotir Ātmā Nārāyaṇaḥ Paraḥ
Nārāyaṇa Paraṃ Brahma Tattvaṃ Nārāyaṇaḥ Paraḥ

content.shloka:
Yachcha Kinchijjagat Sarvam Drishyate Shrooyatepi Vaa
Antarbahishcha Tatsarvam Vyaapya Naarayanah Sthitah
content.meaning: Whatever exists in this entire universe, whether seen or heard, all of it — both inside and outside — Narayana pervades and abides in everything.
content.transliteration:
Yacca Kiñcijjagat Sarvaṃ Dṛśyate Śrūyatepi Vā
Antarbahiśca Tatsarvaṃ Vyāpya Nārāyaṇaḥ Sthitaḥ

content.shloka:
Sa Brahma Sa Shivah Sendrah Soksharah Paramah Svaraat
Sa Eva Vishnuh Sa Praanah Sa Kaalo Agnih Sa Chandramah
content.meaning: He is Brahma, He is Shiva, He is Indra; He is the imperishable, the supreme, the self-luminous. He alone is Vishnu, He is the life-breath, He is time, fire, and the moon.
content.transliteration:
Sa Brahmā Sa Śivaḥ Sendraḥ Sokṣaraḥ Paramaḥ Svarāṭ
Sa Eva Viṣṇuḥ Sa Prāṇaḥ Sa Kālo Agniḥ Sa Candramāḥ

content.shloka:
Sahasra Sheershaa Purushah Sahasraakshah Sahasra Paat
Sa Bhoomim Vishvato Vritvaaa Atyatishthat Dashaangulam
content.meaning: The Purusha (Cosmic Being) has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, and a thousand feet. He pervades the earth on all sides and extends beyond it by ten finger-breadths.
content.transliteration:
Sahasra Śīrṣā Puruṣaḥ Sahasrākṣaḥ Sahasra Pāt
Sa Bhūmiṃ Viśvato Vṛtvā Atyatiṣṭhat Daśāṅgulam

content.shloka:
Purusha Evedagum Sarvam Yadbhootam Yachcha Bhavyam
Utaamritatvasyeshaano Yadannenaa Tirohati
content.meaning: The Purusha alone is all this — what has been and what is yet to be. He is the Lord of immortality, and also of that which grows through food.
content.transliteration:
Puruṣa Evedaguṃ Sarvaṃ Yadbhūtaṃ Yacca Bhavyam
Utāmṛtatvasyeśāno Yadannenā Tirohati

content.shloka:
Etaavaan Asya Mahimaa Ato Jyaayaagumshcha Poorushah
Paado Asya Vishvaa Bhootaani Tripaadasyaamritam Divi
content.meaning: Such is His greatness, and the Purusha is even greater than this. All beings form but one quarter of Him; three quarters of Him are the immortal realm in heaven.
content.transliteration:
Etāvān Asya Mahimā Ato Jyāyāguṃśca Pūruṣaḥ
Pādo Asya Viśvā Bhūtāni Tripādasyāmṛtaṃ Divi

content.shloka:
Tasmaad Viraat Ajaayata Viraajo Adhi Poorushah
Sa Jaato Atyarichyata Pashchaad Bhoomim Atho Purah
content.meaning: From Him was born the cosmic body (Virat). From Virat was born the Purusha. Being born, He extended beyond the earth from behind and also from the front.
content.transliteration:
Tasmād Virāṭ Ajāyata Virājo Adhi Pūruṣaḥ
Sa Jāto Atyaricyata Paścād Bhūmim Atho Puraḥ

content.shloka:
Chandramaa Manaso Jaatah Chakshoh Sooryo Ajaayata
Mukhaadindrash Chaagnishcha Praanaat Vaayur Ajaayata
content.meaning: The moon was born from His mind. The sun was born from His eyes. From His mouth came Indra and Agni. From His breath was born the wind god Vayu.
content.transliteration:
Candramā Manaso Jātaḥ Cakṣoḥ Sūryo Ajāyata
Mukhādindraś Cāgniśca Prāṇāt Vāyur Ajāyata

content.shloka:
Vedaa Hametam Purusham Mahaantam Aadityavarnam Tamasah Parastaat
Tamevam Vidvaanamrita Iha Bhavati Naanyah Panthaa Ayanaaya Vidyate
content.meaning: I know this great Purusha, who is luminous like the sun and beyond all darkness. Only by knowing Him does one transcend death in this very life. There is no other path for liberation.
content.transliteration:
Vedāhametaṃ Puruṣaṃ Mahāntam Ādityavarṇaṃ Tamasaḥ Parastāt
Tamevaṃ Vidvānamṛta Iha Bhavati Nānyaḥ Panthā Ayanāya Vidyate

content.shloka:
Hiranyavarnaam Harineem Suvarna Rajata Srajaam
Chandraam Hiranmayeem Lakshmeem Jaatavedo Ma Aavaha
content.meaning: O Jataveda (fire god), bring to me Lakshmi, who is golden-hued, radiant like a deer, adorned with garlands of gold and silver, who is luminous like the moon and golden in form.
content.transliteration:
Hiraṇyavarṇāṃ Hariṇīṃ Suvarṇa Rajata Srajām
Candrāṃ Hiraṇmayīṃ Lakṣmīṃ Jātavedo Ma Āvaha

content.shloka:
Taam Ma Aavaha Jaatavedo Lakshmeem Anapagaamineem
Yasyaam Hiranyam Vindeyam Gaam Ashvam Purushaanaham
content.meaning: O Jataveda, bring to me that Lakshmi who will never leave me, through whom I shall obtain gold, cattle, horses, and progeny.
content.transliteration:
Tāṃ Ma Āvaha Jātavedo Lakṣmīm Anapagāminīm
Yasyāṃ Hiraṇyaṃ Vindeyaṃ Gām Aśvaṃ Puruṣānaham

content.shloka:
Ashvapoornaam Rathamadhyaam Hastinaaada Prabodhiniim
Shriyam Deveem Upahvaye Shreerma Devee Jushataam
content.meaning: I invoke the goddess Shri (Lakshmi), who is heralded by elephants, surrounded by horses and chariots, who awakens with the trumpeting of elephants. May the divine goddess Shri be pleased with me.
content.transliteration:
Aśvapūrṇāṃ Rathamadhyāṃ Hastināda Prabodhinīm
Śriyaṃ Devīm Upahvaye Śrīrma Devī Juṣatām

content.shloka:
Kaam Sosmitaam Hiranya Praakaaraam Aardraam Jvalanteem Triptaam Tarpayanteem
Padme Sthitaam Padma Varnaam Taamihopahvaye Shriyam
content.meaning: I invoke here that Shri (Lakshmi) who is the embodiment of desire, smiling, surrounded by a golden aura, compassionate, radiant, contented, and nourishing all — who stands upon a lotus and is lotus-complexioned.
content.transliteration:
Kāṃ Sosmitāṃ Hiraṇya Prākārāṃ Ārdrāṃ Jvalantīṃ Tṛptāṃ Tarpayantīm
Padme Sthitāṃ Padma Varṇāṃ Tāmihopahvaye Śriyam

content.shloka:
Aadityavarne Tapaso Adhijaato Vanaspatistava Vrikshothha Bilvah
Tasya Phalaani Tapasaa Nudantu Maayaantaraayaashcha Baahyaa Alakshmeeh
content.meaning: O goddess of solar radiance, from your austerity was born the bilva tree among forest trees. May its fruits, through their spiritual power, drive away both internal illusions and external misfortune.
content.transliteration:
Ādityavarṇe Tapaso Adhijāto Vanaspatiḥ Tava Vṛkṣothha Bilvaḥ
Tasya Phalāni Tapasā Nudantu Māyāntarāyāśca Bāhyā Alakṣmīḥ

content.shloka:
Shriye Jaata Shriya Aaniriyaaya Shriyam Vaayo Janitriksheerameesh
Shriyam Vasaanaa Amritavaamajaataam Bhajaami Lakshmeemanalasya Raamaam
content.meaning: Born for Shri, entering into Shri, for Shri alone — O Vayu, you are the mother's milk of prosperity. Wearing Shri as her garment, born from the immortal nectar, I worship Lakshmi, the beloved of the imperishable Lord.
content.transliteration:
Śriye Jāta Śriya Āniriyāya Śriyaṃ Vāyo Janitṛkṣīrameśa
Śriyaṃ Vasānā Amṛtavāmajātāṃ Bhajāmi Lakṣmīmanalasya Rāmām
